# Baseline A Narrative Synthesis: Mammoth Biosciences, Inc.

Case: dev-biotech-mammoth-2021
Cutoff: 2021-09-09
Input fingerprint: 7b1cd237c4eb

## Narrative
- Mammoth Biosciences, Inc. is summarized from 3 cutoff-visible public evidence records dated on or before 2021-09-09.
- The normalized claim list contains 9 cited observations from source classes: company-primary, government, peer-reviewed.
- A peer-reviewed Nature Biotechnology article described CRISPR-Cas12-based SARS-CoV-2 detection work involving Mammoth authors.
- FDA historical EUA records list the SARS-CoV-2 DETECTR Reagent Kit with EUA issued on 2020-08-31.
- Mammoth announced USD 195 million of financing on 2021-09-09.
- Mammoth described its platform as next-generation CRISPR products for therapeutics and diagnostics.
- Mammoth said it was focusing on Cas14 and CasPhi systems for in vivo genome editing delivery.

## Evidence Notes
- CRISPR-Cas12-based detection of SARS-CoV-2 [ev-4a0498d1cfc9]
  - A peer-reviewed Nature Biotechnology article described CRISPR-Cas12-based SARS-CoV-2 detection work involving Mammoth authors. (value=CRISPR-Cas12 SARS-CoV-2 detection; period=instant 2020-04-16)
  - The article lists Mammoth Biosciences, Inc. affiliations for James Broughton and Janice Chen. (value=James Broughton, Janice Chen; period=instant 2020-04-16)
- Mammoth Biosciences raises USD 195 million [ev-2df79df4d844]
  - Mammoth announced USD 195 million of financing on 2021-09-09. (value=195; unit=USD millions; period=instant 2021-09-09)
  - Mammoth described its platform as next-generation CRISPR products for therapeutics and diagnostics. (value=CRISPR therapeutics and diagnostics; period=instant 2021-09-09)
  - Mammoth said it was focusing on Cas14 and CasPhi systems for in vivo genome editing delivery. (value=Cas14, CasPhi; period=instant 2021-09-09)
  - Mammoth stated it had expanded its team to more than 100 employees. (value=100; unit=employees, greater than; period=instant 2021-09-09)
  - Mammoth stated the financing included a USD 150 million Series D led by Redmile Group. (value=150; unit=USD millions; period=instant 2021-09-09)
  - Mammoth stated the financing placed the company in unicorn status with valuation greater than USD 1 billion. (value=1; unit=USD billions headline valuation, greater than; period=instant 2021-09-09)
- FDA historical device emergency use authorizations [ev-b73daa03700a]
  - FDA historical EUA records list the SARS-CoV-2 DETECTR Reagent Kit with EUA issued on 2020-08-31. (value=EUA issued; period=instant 2020-08-31)

## Limitations
- This baseline performs deterministic evidence summarization only.
- It does not run TRACE route selection, sufficiency gating, valuation logic, or adversarial review.
- It does not claim official contest compliance, benchmark superiority, investment advice, or appraisal status.
- Source use follows the committed policy: Raw source documents, PDFs, cached pages, and scratch downloads stay out of Git unless redistribution rights are explicitly established.
